scientific_witness.independent_method: For homogeneous Cartesian metrics and lambda3/mu2, use L(u)=mu*Laplacian(u)+(lambda+mu)*grad(div(u)). Manufactured quadratic has div(u)=12x+13y+14z, Laplacian(u)=(2,4,6), hence L=(64,73,82). Constant displacement has L=0. Source operation is initial-L. This analytic witness shares no source finite-difference expressions.
scientific_witness.boundary_evidence_limit: All boundary fields compared against nativeGPU/CUDAjl and scalar source-expression references, not an independently proven SBP discretization. Synthetic original q/1000 coefficient table is not certified as physical boundary data. No time integration, energy stability, convergence or original dataset norm claim.
